propositions: Duplicate tickets are created with identical titles and only discovered during mid-implementation, not at creation time
create_core performs no duplicate/overlap check by design; ADR 0086 placed detection at review time off the hot write path
A rolling recent-creates.json journal with 600s recency window, probed under fcntl.flock at create, achieves 100% precision on same-title + <5min window bursts (7/7 observed true duplicates)
The duplicate advisory must surface non-blockingly on all creation surfaces (CLI stderr, library result dict, MCP field) with candidate ticket id/status/age, never preventing the write

Closed-source tickets cannot receive duplicates links directly; the sanctioned path is reopen → link → re-close --class duplicate, which bypasses completion verification via _administrative_disposition
